subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The graph shows the production of fertilizers by countries X, Y and Z ( in million tonnes) from the year 2016-2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3c72f5eeb837cb557140e3c8cbd7d8aa992818608e14c5cd0c013616cd65bb6.png] 

The ratio of the production of fertilizers by country Z in 2019 to the total production of fertilizers by country X in 2017 and country Y in 2020 is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Production of fertilizers by Country Z in 2019 = 380 million tonnes

Total production of fertilizers by country X in 2017 and country Y in 2020 = 236 + 334 = 570 million tonnes

Ratio = 380 : 570 = 2 : 3

**The required ratio is 2 : 3.**
